FROM oraclelinux:9-slim AS stock-runtime
RUN microdnf install -y tar gzip curl ca-certificates && microdnf clean all
RUN curl -fL https://download.oracle.com/java/25/latest/jdk-25_linux-x64_bin.tar.gz -o /tmp/jdk.tar.gz \
    && mkdir -p /opt/java/openjdk && tar -xzf /tmp/jdk.tar.gz -C /opt/java/openjdk --strip-components=1 \
    && sha256sum /tmp/jdk.tar.gz > /oracle-jdk-sha256.txt && rm /tmp/jdk.tar.gz
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/openjdk
ENV PATH=/opt/java/openjdk/bin:$PATH
FROM stock-runtime AS os-source
RUN rm -rf /opt/java/openjdk
FROM scratch AS common-os
COPY --from=os-source / /
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/openjdk
ENV PATH=/opt/java/openjdk/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LANGUAGE=en_US:en LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
WORKDIR /app
COPY docker/build-provenance.json build-provenance.json
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/java"]

FROM common-os AS base
COPY --from=stock-runtime /opt/java/openjdk /opt/java/openjdk

FROM base AS guicedee
COPY guicedee/.env .env
COPY guicedee/target/comparison-guicedee-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
COPY guicedee/target/lib/ lib/
CMD ["--module-path", "/app/app.jar:/app/lib", "-m", "bench.guicedee/bench.guicedee.Main"]

FROM base AS quarkus
COPY quarkus/target/quarkus-app/ ./
CMD ["-jar", "/app/quarkus-run.jar"]

FROM base AS guicedee-scan
COPY guicedee-scan/.env .env
COPY guicedee-scan/target/comparison-guicedee-scan-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
COPY guicedee-scan/target/lib/ lib/
ENV GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE=scan
CMD ["--module-path", "/app/app.jar:/app/lib", "-m", "bench.guicedee.scan/bench.guicedee.Main"]

FROM stock-runtime AS maven-build-base
RUN microdnf install -y binutils && microdnf clean all
ARG MAVEN_VERSION=4.0.0-rc-7
ADD https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/${MAVEN_VERSION}/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}-bin.zip /tmp/maven.zip
RUN cd /opt && jar xf /tmp/maven.zip && chmod +x /opt/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}/bin/mvn && rm /tmp/maven.zip
ENV PATH=/opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7/bin:$PATH
COPY docker/repository/ /root/.m2/repository/
WORKDIR /src
COPY pom.xml pom.xml
COPY common/ common/
COPY guicedee/pom.xml guicedee/pom.xml
COPY guicedee/src/ guicedee/src/
COPY guicedee-scan/pom.xml guicedee-scan/pom.xml
COPY guicedee-scan/src/ guicedee-scan/src/
COPY quarkus/pom.xml quarkus/pom.xml
COPY quarkus/src/ quarkus/src/
COPY quarkus-native/pom.xml quarkus-native/pom.xml
COPY guicedee-native/pom.xml guicedee-native/pom.xml
COPY guicedee-jlink/ guicedee-jlink/
COPY guicedee-scan-jlink/ guicedee-scan-jlink/

FROM maven-build-base AS application-build
RUN mvn -B -ntp -pl guicedee-jlink,guicedee-scan-jlink -am package -DskipTests

FROM common-os AS guicedee-jlink
COPY --from=application-build /src/guicedee-jlink/target/maven-jlink/default /opt/java/openjdk
COPY guicedee/.env .env
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark"]

FROM quay.io/quarkus/ubi9-quarkus-mandrel-builder-image:jdk-25@sha256:c0ff31764f70469795db5513d674e4721fd8e7e761beddbff741ef5d84e79ed3 AS native-build
USER root
COPY --from=maven-build-base /opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7 /opt/maven
COPY --from=maven-build-base /root/.m2/repository /root/.m2/repository
COPY --from=maven-build-base /src /src
WORKDIR /src
COPY quarkus-native/src/ quarkus-native/src/
COPY quarkus-native/native-metadata-inputs.json quarkus-native/native-metadata-inputs.json
RUN native-image --version > /native-build-info.txt && \
    /opt/maven/bin/mvn -B -ntp -pl quarkus-native -am package -Pnative -DskipTests && \
    sha256sum /src/quarkus-native/target/*-runner >> /native-build-info.txt

FROM common-os AS quarkus-native
COPY --from=native-build /src/quarkus-native/target/*-runner /app/application
COPY --from=native-build /native-build-info.txt /app/native-build-info.txt
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/application"]

FROM quay.io/quarkus/ubi9-quarkus-mandrel-builder-image:jdk-25@sha256:c0ff31764f70469795db5513d674e4721fd8e7e761beddbff741ef5d84e79ed3 AS guicedee-native-build
USER root
COPY --from=maven-build-base /opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7 /opt/maven
COPY --from=maven-build-base /root/.m2/repository /root/.m2/repository
COPY --from=maven-build-base /src /src
WORKDIR /src
COPY quarkus-native/src/ quarkus-native/src/
COPY guicedee-native/src/ guicedee-native/src/
COPY guicedee-native/build-native.sh guicedee-native/build-native.sh
COPY guicedee-native/NativeModuleAccess.java guicedee-native/NativeModuleAccess.java
COPY guicedee-native/native-resources.txt guicedee-native/native-resources.txt
RUN /opt/maven/bin/mvn -B -ntp -pl guicedee-native -am package -Pnative -DskipTests

FROM common-os AS guicedee-native
COPY --from=guicedee-native-build /src/guicedee-native/target/application /app/application
COPY --from=guicedee-native-build /src/guicedee-native/target/*.so /app/
COPY --from=guicedee-native-build /src/guicedee-native/target/native-build-info.txt /app/native-build-info.txt
COPY guicedee/.env .env
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/application"]

FROM common-os AS guicedee-scan-jlink
COPY --from=application-build /src/guicedee-scan-jlink/target/maven-jlink/default /opt/java/openjdk
COPY guicedee-scan/.env .env
ENV GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE=scan
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark"]

# Optional diagnostic build: compile all measured Java sources against the staged
# repository inside Linux, independent of a concurrently changing host Maven cache.
FROM application-build AS phase-application-build
RUN mvn -B -ntp -pl quarkus -am package -DskipTests

FROM base AS phase-quarkus
COPY --from=phase-application-build /src/quarkus/target/quarkus-app/ /app/
CMD ["-jar", "/app/quarkus-run.jar"]

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
native-image --version > target/native-build-info.txt
java NativeModuleAccess.java target/lib target/native-module-access.args native-resources.txt target/modular-resources
# Native Image loads Java modules from a directory but does not discover each JAR's embedded
# reachability metadata there. Enumerate the JARs so library-owned metadata is applied as well.
MODULE_PATH=$(find target/lib -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.jar' | sort | paste -sd ':' -)
native-image -J-Xmx8g --no-fallback -O2 -march=x86-64-v3 --gc=serial \
    @target/native-module-access.args \
    -H:ConfigurationFileDirectories=target/modular-resources \
    --module-path "target/comparison-guicedee-native-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar:$MODULE_PATH" \
    --add-modules=bench.guicedee.nativeimage,jdk.unsupported \
    --add-reads=firebase.admin=org.graalvm.nativeimage \
    --add-reads=commercetools.sdk.java.api=org.graalvm.nativeimage \
    --features=com.guicedee.nativeimage.GuiceNativeFeature \
    --initialize-at-run-time=io.netty \
    --exclude-config '.*firebase-admin.*' '/META-INF/native-image/.*' \
    --exclude-config '.*commercetools.*' '/META-INF/native-image/.*' \
    -m bench.guicedee/bench.guicedee.Main -o target/application
sha256sum target/application >> target/native-build-info.txt

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <parent><groupId>dev.guicedee.benchmarks</groupId><artifactId>service-comparison</artifactId><version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version></parent>
    <artifactId>comparison-guicedee-native</artifactId>
    <dependencies>
        <!-- The existing application JAR is used unchanged, including its module descriptor. -->
        <dependency><groupId>dev.guicedee.benchmarks</groupId><artifactId>comparison-guicedee</artifactId><version>${project.version}</version></dependency>
        <dependency><groupId>com.guicedee</groupId><artifactId>native-image</artifactId><version>${guicedee.version}</version></dependency>
        <dependency><groupId>org.graalvm.sdk</groupId><artifactId>nativeimage</artifactId><version>25.0.4.1</version><scope>provided</scope></dependency>
    </dependencies>
    <build>
        <resources>
            <resource><directory>${project.basedir}/../quarkus-native/src/main/resources</directory></resource>
            <resource><directory>src/main/resources</directory></resource>
        </resources>
        <plugins>
            <plugin><groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId><artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration><compilerArgs>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>commercetools.sdk.java.api/com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.channel=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>commercetools.sdk.java.api/com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.channel.embedded=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>commercetools.sdk.java.api/com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.handler.codec.compression=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>commercetools.sdk.java.api/com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.handler.codec.http=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>commercetools.sdk.java.api/com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.handler.ssl=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>commercetools.sdk.java.api/com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.util=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>firebase.admin/com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.io.grpc.netty.shaded.io.netty.buffer=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                    <arg>--add-exports</arg><arg>firebase.admin/com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.io.grpc.netty.shaded.io.netty.util.internal.logging=bench.guicedee.nativeimage</arg>
                </compilerArgs></configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin><groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId><artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId><version>3.8.0</version>
                <executions><execution><id>shared-sdk-native-compatibility</id><phase>generate-sources</phase><goals><goal>add-source</goal></goals>
                    <configuration><sources><source>${project.basedir}/../quarkus-native/src/main/java</source></sources></configuration>
                </execution></executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin><groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId><artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions><execution><id>native-module-path</id><phase>prepare-package</phase><goals><goal>copy-dependencies</goal></goals>
                    <configuration><includeScope>compile</includeScope><outputDirectory>${project.build.directory}/lib</outputDirectory></configuration>
                </execution></executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
    <profiles><profile><id>native</id><build><plugins>
        <plugin><groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId><artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId><version>3.6.4</version>
            <executions><execution><id>native-executable</id><phase>package</phase><goals><goal>exec</goal></goals>
                <configuration><executable>sh</executable><arguments><argument>${project.basedir}/build-native.sh</argument></arguments></configuration>
            </execution></executions>
        </plugin>
    </plugins></build></profile></profiles>
</project>

"""Fresh-process capability and latency comparison; failed parity never becomes a performance win."""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import socket
import statistics
import subprocess
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from upstream import Upstream
from variants import select_variants, ordered_variants, paired_image_variants, guicedee_jar, guicedee_project, runtime_flags

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def request(base, path, body=None, raw=None, headers=None, timeout=15):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(base+path, data=data, headers=headers or {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
            status, content = response.status, response.read().decode()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as response:
        with response:
            status, content = response.code, response.read().decode()
    try: parsed = json.loads(content)
    except ValueError: parsed = content
    return status, parsed, (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000


def port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def stop(process):
    if process.poll() is not None: return
    if os.name == "nt":
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    else:
        import signal
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    try: process.wait(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        if os.name != "nt": os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait(timeout=5)


def start(command, log, env, cwd=ROOT):
    return subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP if os.name == "nt" else 0,
                            start_new_session=os.name != "nt")


def percentile(values, quantile):
    return sorted(values)[min(len(values)-1, int((len(values)-1)*quantile))]


def metric_counts(body):
    if not isinstance(body, str): return {}
    values = {}
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('#') or 'benchmark_quotes' not in line: continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?)\s+([0-9.eE+\-]+)(?:\s+[0-9]+)?', line)
        if match: values[match[1]] = float(match[2])
    return values


def eligible_comparison(rows, runs, variants):
    expected = {(v['id'], run) for v in variants for run in range(1, runs+1)}
    actual = {(r.get('variant'), r.get('run')) for r in rows}
    return len(variants) > 1 and len(rows) == len(expected) and actual == expected and all(
        r.get('eligible', False) and not r.get('instrumented', False) for r in rows)


def phase_evidence(log, directory, framework):
    operations = [json.loads(line.split('BENCH_PHASE ', 1)[1]) for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith('BENCH_PHASE ')]
    expected = {'workload-construction', 'first-quote', 'first-firestore'}
    names = [o['operation'] for o in operations]
    # CDI client proxies may run superclass field initializers too. Retain those
    # extra constructions as evidence; require exactly one exercised SDK flow.
    passed = set(names) == expected and names.count('first-quote') == 1 and names.count('first-firestore') == 1 and all(o['success'] for o in operations)
    startup = directory/'startup.json'
    core = json.loads(startup.read_text()) if startup.is_file() else None
    if framework == 'guicedee':
        passed = passed and core is not None and core['droppedEvents'] == 0 and all(e['success'] for e in core['events'])
        passed = passed and {'application-startup', 'guice-create-injector', 'pre-startup', 'post-startup'}.issubset(
            {e['phase'] for e in core['events']} if core else set())
    return {'verified':bool(passed), 'workload':operations, 'startup':core}


def discovery_evidence(log, discovery):
    scanning = 'Initializing ClassGraph scanner for dependency discovery' in log
    deployments = {package: f'Deploying Verticle: {package} -' in log
                   for package in ['bench.guicedee.rest', 'bench.guicedee.service']}
    return {'classGraphInitialized':scanning, 'verticleDeployments':deployments,
            'verified':scanning == (discovery == 'scan') and all(deployments.values()),
            'logLines':[line for line in log.splitlines() if any(marker in line for marker in
                         ['Initializing ClassGraph', 'Classpath scan completed', 'Deploying Verticle: bench.guicedee'])]}


def probe(variant, run, out, upstream, flags, args):
    flags = runtime_flags(variant, flags)
    framework = variant['framework']
    application = guicedee_project(variant) if framework == 'guicedee' else 'quarkus-native' if variant['runtime']=='native' else 'quarkus'
    app_port = port()
    env = dict(os.environ, HTTP_PORT=str(app_port), HTTPS_ENABLED="false", HTTP_HOST="127.0.0.1",
               BENCH_UPSTREAM=f"http://127.0.0.1:{upstream.server_port}", FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST="127.0.0.1:18088",
               GCLOUD_PROJECT="demo-devsuite")
    # Remove implicit JVM tuning from the parent so both variants receive exactly the recorded flags.
    for name in ["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS"]: env.pop(name, None)
    if framework == "guicedee":
        env['GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE']=variant['discovery']
        cp = (ROOT/application/'target/classpath.txt').read_text().strip() if not args.docker else ''
        module = 'bench.guicedee.scan' if variant['discovery'] == 'scan' else 'bench.guicedee'
        launch = [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['--module-path', str(ROOT/application/'target'/guicedee_jar(variant))+os.pathsep+cp, '-m', module+'/bench.guicedee.Main']
    else: launch = [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['-jar', str(ROOT/'quarkus/target/quarkus-app/quarkus-run.jar')]
    name = f'{variant["id"]}-{run}'
    diagnostics = getattr(args, 'diagnostics', False)
    diagnostic_dir = out/(name+'-diagnostics')
    if diagnostics:
        diagnostic_dir.mkdir()
        env['BENCH_PHASE_DIAGNOSTICS']='true'
        env['GUICEDEE_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR']=str(diagnostic_dir.resolve())
    container = None
    if args.docker:
        container = 'devsuite-bench-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        env.update(HTTP_PORT='8080', HTTP_HOST='0.0.0.0', QUARKUS_HTTP_HOST='0.0.0.0',
                   BENCH_UPSTREAM=f'http://host.docker.internal:{upstream.server_port}',
                   FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST='host.docker.internal:18088')
        launch = (['-m', module+'/bench.guicedee.Main'] if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else ['--module-path','/app/app.jar:/app/lib','-m',module+'/bench.guicedee.Main']) if framework=='guicedee' else [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['-jar','/app/quarkus-run.jar']
        if variant['runtime']=='native': launch=[]
    argfile = out/(name+'.args')
    argfile.write_text('\n'.join('"'+a.replace('\\','/')+'"' for a in flags+launch)+'\n')
    log = (out/(name+'.log')).open('w')
    started = time.perf_counter()
    command = [shutil.which('java'), '@'+str(argfile)]
    if variant['runtime'] == 'jlink' and not container:
        launcher = ROOT/(application+'-jlink')/'target/maven-jlink/default/bin'/('benchmark.bat' if os.name == 'nt' else 'benchmark')
        if not launcher.is_file(): raise RuntimeError('Build the application jlink module first: '+str(launcher))
        env['JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS']=' '.join(flags)
        command = [str(launcher)]
    if container:
        command = ['docker','run','--name',container,'--cpus','0.25','--memory','500m','--memory-swap','500m',
                   '--publish',f'127.0.0.1:{app_port}:8080']
        if diagnostics:
            env['GUICEDEE_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR']='/diagnostics'
            command += ['--mount',f'type=bind,source={diagnostic_dir.resolve()},target=/diagnostics',
                        '--env','BENCH_PHASE_DIAGNOSTICS=true']
        for key in ['HTTP_PORT','HTTPS_ENABLED','HTTP_HOST','QUARKUS_HTTP_HOST','BENCH_UPSTREAM','FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST',
                    'GCLOUD_PROJECT']:
            command += ['--env',key+'='+env[key]]
        if framework=='guicedee':
            # Defaults stay in the image's .env. Explicit host overrides retain their normal precedence.
            for key in sorted(env):
                if key.startswith(('GUICEDEE_', 'VERTX_', 'METRICS_', 'TELEMETRY_', 'OTEL_')):
                    command += ['--env',key+'='+env[key]]
            local_env=ROOT/application/'.env.local'
            if local_env.exists():
                command += ['--mount',f'type=bind,source={local_env},target=/app/.env.local,readonly']
        if variant['runtime'] == 'jlink':
            command += ['--env', 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS='+' '.join(flags), args.images[variant['id']]]
        else:
            command += [args.images[variant['id']],*flags,*launch]
    process = start(command, log, env, ROOT/application)
    base = f'http://127.0.0.1:{app_port}'
    row = {'framework': framework, 'variant': variant['id'], 'discovery': variant['discovery'],
           'runtime': variant['runtime'], 'run': run, 'checks': {}, 'samples': [],
           'runtimeFlags':flags, 'jvmFlags':[] if variant['runtime']=='native' else flags,
           'jvmFlagsSource':'not-applicable' if variant['runtime']=='native' else 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS' if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else 'arguments',
           'launch': (['/app/application',*flags] if variant['runtime']=='native' else [('/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark' if container else str(launcher))] if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else flags+launch)}
    if 'comparisonRole' in variant:
        row.update(comparisonRole=variant['comparisonRole'],imageArtifact=variant['imageArtifact'],imageTag=variant['imageTag'])
    event_start = len(upstream.events)
    def check(name, condition, observed):
        row['checks'][name] = {'passed': bool(condition), 'observed': observed}
    try:
        deadline = started + 120
        while time.perf_counter() < deadline:
            if process.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError(f'Application exited {process.returncode}; see {name}.log')
            try:
                response = request(base, '/ready', timeout=.5)
                if response[:2] == (200, {'ready': True}): break
            except (OSError, TimeoutError): pass
            time.sleep(.05)
        else: raise TimeoutError('Readiness timed out')
        row['launchToReadyMs'] = (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
        route = '/quote?persist=true' if args.firebase else '/quote'
        order = {'sku': 'fixture', 'quantity': 2}
        expected = {'sku': 'fixture', 'quantity': 2, 'total': 250, 'available': 40, 'project': 'Fixture shop'}
        status, body, latency = request(base, route, order, timeout=60 if args.docker else 15)
        row['firstBusinessStatus'] = status
        row['firstBusinessMs'] = latency
        row['launchToFirstBusinessMs'] = (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
        check('business', status == 200 and body == expected, {'status': status, 'body': body})
        events = upstream.events[event_start:]
        for label, path in [('vendorSdkOAuth','/oauth/token'),('vendorSdkRest','/benchmark'),('graphqlClient','/benchmark/graphql')]:
            hits = [e for e in events if e['path'] == path]
            check(label, bool(hits) and all(e['status']==200 for e in hits), hits)
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/quote', order)
        check('optionalPrimitiveQuery', status==200 and body==expected, {'status':status,'body':body})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/quote?persist=false', {'sku':'fixture','quantity':0})
        check('validationError', status==400 and body=={'error':{'code':'INVALID_ORDER','status':400}}, {'status':status,'body':body})
        for label, data, header, expected_status in [('malformedJson',b'{',{'Content-Type':'application/json'},400),
                                                    ('unsupportedMedia',b'hello',{'Content-Type':'text/plain'},415)]:
            status, body, _ = request(base, '/quote?persist=false', raw=data, headers=header)
            check(label, status==expected_status, {'status':status,'body':body})
        retry_id = name
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/retry/'+retry_id)
        attempts = upstream.counts['/flaky/'+retry_id]
        check('reactiveRetry', status==200 and body=={'result':'ok'} and attempts==3, {'status':status,'body':body,'attempts':attempts})
        previous = upstream.counts['/flaky/always']
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/retry/always')
        attempts = upstream.counts['/flaky/always']-previous
        check('retryExhaustion', status==502 and body=={'error':{'code':'UPSTREAM_FAILURE','status':502}} and attempts==3,
              {'status':status,'body':body,'attempts':attempts})
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as pool:
            pending = pool.submit(request, base, '/timeout')
            time.sleep(.02)
            _, _, ready_ms = request(base, '/ready')
            status, body, elapsed = pending.result()
        check('reactiveTimeout', status==504 and body=={'error':{'code':'UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT','status':504}} and elapsed<(1000 if args.docker else 225),
              {'status':status,'body':body,'elapsedMs':elapsed,'concurrentReadyMs':ready_ms})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/metrics', headers={})
        before = metric_counts(body)
        request(base, route, order)
        after_status, after_body, _ = request(base, '/metrics', headers={})
        after = metric_counts(after_body)
        check('metrics', status==200 and after_status==200 and any(after.get(k,0)>v for k,v in before.items()),
              {'status':status,'before':before,'after':after})
        status, body, latency = request(base, '/openapi.json', headers={'Accept':'application/json'})
        row['firstOpenApiJsonMs'] = latency
        if status == 200 and isinstance(body, dict):
            (out/f'{variant["id"]}-{run}-openapi.json').write_text(json.dumps(body,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        check('openapi', status==200 and isinstance(body,dict) and '/quote' in body.get('paths',{}), {'status':status,'paths':list(body.get('paths',{})) if isinstance(body,dict) else body[:300]})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/swagger/' if framework=='quarkus' else '/swagger/index.html', headers={})
        assets={}
        for asset,marker in [('swagger-ui-bundle.js','SwaggerUIBundle'),('swagger-ui.css','.swagger-ui')]:
            asset_status,asset_body,_=request(base,'/swagger/'+asset,headers={})
            assets[asset]={'status':asset_status,'contentLength':len(asset_body),
                           'valid':asset_status==200 and isinstance(asset_body,str) and marker in asset_body}
        check('swagger', status==200 and isinstance(body,str) and 'swagger' in body.lower()
              and all(asset['valid'] for asset in assets.values()), {'status':status,'assets':assets})
        if args.firebase:
            status, body, _ = request(base, '/firebase/'+name)
            check('firebaseFirestore', status==200 and body=={'id':name,'sku':'fixture','total':250}, {'status':status,'body':body})
        else: row['checks']['firebaseFirestore']={'passed':False,'status':'not_run','reason':'--firebase not selected'}
        # Diagnostic warm latency is retained even if parity fails; reports cannot rank that run.
        for _ in range(args.warmup): request(base, route, order)
        for _ in range(args.requests):
            status, body, elapsed = request(base, route, order)
            row['samples'].append({'ms':elapsed,'ok':status==200 and body==expected,'status':status})
        times=[s['ms'] for s in row['samples']]
        row['warm']={'p50Ms':statistics.median(times),'p95Ms':percentile(times,.95),'p99Ms':percentile(times,.99),
                     'failures':sum(not s['ok'] for s in row['samples']), 'requests':len(times),'concurrency':1}
        row['eligible'] = all(c['passed'] for c in row['checks'].values()) and row['warm']['failures']==0
    except Exception as error:
        row['error']=str(error);row['eligible']=False
    finally:
        if container:
            inspected=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect',container],capture_output=True,text=True)
            if inspected.returncode==0:
                details=json.loads(inspected.stdout)[0]
                row['container']={'image':details['Image'],'state':details['State'],
                                  'nanoCpus':details['HostConfig']['NanoCpus'],'memoryBytes':details['HostConfig']['Memory'],
                                  'memorySwapBytes':details['HostConfig']['MemorySwap']}
                row['containerStats']=subprocess.run(['docker','exec',container,'sh','-c',
                    'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events'],
                    capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
                if row['container']['nanoCpus']!=250000000 or row['container']['memoryBytes']!=524288000 or details['State']['OOMKilled']:
                    row['eligible']=False
            else: row['eligible']=False
            subprocess.run(['docker','rm','-f',container],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        stop(process);log.close()
        if framework == 'guicedee':
            row['discoveryEvidence']=discovery_evidence((out/(name+'.log')).read_text(errors='replace'), variant['discovery'])
            row['eligible']=row['eligible'] and row['discoveryEvidence']['verified']
        row['upstreamEvents']=upstream.events[event_start:]
        if diagnostics:
            row['instrumented']=True
            row['capabilitiesPassed']=row['eligible']
            row['phaseEvidence']=phase_evidence((out/(name+'.log')).read_text(errors='replace'), diagnostic_dir, framework)
            row['eligible']=False
        (out/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(name, 'eligible='+str(row['eligible']), 'failed='+str([k for k,v in row['checks'].items() if not v['passed']]), row.get('error',''), flush=True)
    return row


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--runs',type=int,default=5)
    parser.add_argument('--requests',type=int,default=100)
    parser.add_argument('--warmup',type=int,default=20)
    parser.add_argument('--firebase',action='store_true',help='Start the official Firestore emulator; required for full parity')
    parser.add_argument('--tiered',action='store_true',help='Apply TieredStopAtLevel=1 to BOTH frameworks')
    parser.add_argument('--docker',action='store_true',help='Use built Linux images with enforced 250m CPU / 500Mi RAM')
    parser.add_argument('--discovery',choices=['scan','spi','both'],default='both',help='Select separate SPI/scanner artifacts; default compares both')
    parser.add_argument('--runtime',choices=['jre','jlink','both','native'],default='jre',help='JVM, linked application, or native executables (Docker only)')
    parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true',help='Include the separate GuicedEE SPI and Quarkus native projects in the selected matrix')
    parser.add_argument('--framework',choices=['both','guicedee','quarkus'],default='both')
    parser.add_argument('--diagnostics',action='store_true',help='Collect startup/SDK phases and live scan/binding inventories; never a performance comparison')
    parser.add_argument('--image-tag',default='local',help='Docker image tag; immutable IDs are resolved before running')
    parser.add_argument('--baseline-image-tag',help='Alternate a baseline tag with --image-tag in the same JVM/Docker batch')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if min(args.runs,args.requests)<1 or args.warmup<0: parser.error('Invalid run/request counts')
    variants = select_variants(args.framework, args.discovery, args.runtime, args.native)
    if args.baseline_image_tag:
        if not args.docker: parser.error('Paired image comparisons require --docker')
        try: variants = paired_image_variants(variants,args.baseline_image_tag,args.image_tag)
        except ValueError as error: parser.error(str(error))
    if not variants: parser.error('No supported variants selected; GuicedEE native requires SPI discovery and application jlink is GuicedEE-only')
    if any(v['runtime']=='native' for v in variants) and not args.docker:
        parser.error('Native comparison requires --docker (the executable is built for Linux)')
    if args.diagnostics and (not args.firebase or any(v['runtime']=='native' for v in variants)):
        parser.error('Phase diagnostics require --firebase and the instrumented JVM builds; native is not part of this diagnostic')
    out=ROOT/'results'/time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    flags=['-Xms128m','-Xmx384m','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2']+(['-XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1'] if args.tiered else [])
    inputs=[]
    for directory in [ROOT/'guicedee/target',ROOT/'guicedee-scan/target',ROOT/'quarkus/target/quarkus-app']:
        for file in directory.rglob('*.jar'):
            inputs.append({'path':str(file.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    for application in ['guicedee','guicedee-scan']:
        cp=ROOT/application/'target/classpath.txt'
        if cp.exists():
            for path in cp.read_text().strip().split(os.pathsep):
                file=Path(path);inputs.append({'path':str(file),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    meta={'platform':platform.platform(),'java':subprocess.run(['java','-version'],capture_output=True,text=True).stderr,
          'flags':flags,'arguments':dict(vars(args)),'variants':variants,'inputs':inputs,'cpuQuota':'Docker 0.25 CPU / 500Mi RAM' if args.docker else 'unrestricted host; ActiveProcessorCount is NOT a CPU limit',
          'executionModel':'application-module-path-native-v2', 'historicalComparison':False,'profile':'firebase-full' if args.firebase else 'without-firebase',
          'sourceRevision':subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()}
    meta['linkedRuntimeArtifacts']={}
    if not args.docker:
        for application in ['guicedee','guicedee-scan']:
            image=ROOT/(application+'-jlink')/'target/maven-jlink/default'
            if (image/'lib/modules').is_file():
                meta['linkedRuntimeArtifacts'][application]={
                    'modulesSha256':hashlib.sha256((image/'lib/modules').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                    'release':(image/'release').read_text(),
                    'modules':subprocess.check_output([str(image/'bin'/('java.exe' if os.name=='nt' else 'java')), '--list-modules'],text=True)}
    meta['benchmarkSources']=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                              for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and (p.suffix in ['.java','.py','.xml','.properties','.ps1'] or p.name=='.env')
                              and not any(part in ['target','node_modules','repository','results','.idea','analysis'] for part in p.relative_to(ROOT).parts)]
    meta['guicedeeLocalEnvSha256']={}

"""Prepare native inputs from a successful GuicedEE trace and the isolated SDK snapshot."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import zipfile
from image_provenance import ROOT, capture
from import_native_trace import verify_sdk_inputs


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def prepare(trace=None):
    repository=ROOT/'docker/repository'
    manifest_path=ROOT/'guicedee-native/native-trace-inputs.json'
    diagnostic=json.loads((trace/'diagnostic.json' if trace else manifest_path).read_text())
    check_count=len(diagnostic.get('checks',{})) if trace else diagnostic.get('capabilityCount',0)
    if not diagnostic.get('allCapabilitiesPassed') or check_count!=15:
        raise ValueError('Native metadata requires a successful full GuicedEE capability trace')
    sdk_inputs=[]
    for sdk in ['firebase-admin','commercetools']:
        jar=repository/f'com/guicedee/modules/services/{sdk}/2.5.1/{sdk}-2.5.1.jar'
        sdk_inputs.append({'name':jar.name,'sha256':sha(jar)})
    verify_sdk_inputs(diagnostic['sdkJars'],sdk_inputs)
    staged=[]
    for source,coordinate in [('services/Google/guice-core','modules/services/guice'),('native-image','native-image'),
                              ('openapi','openapi'),('swagger-ui','swagger-ui')]:
        name=coordinate.split('/')[-1]
        directory=ROOT.parent/'GuicedEE'/source
        jar=directory/f'target/{name}-2.5.1.jar'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive:
            if 'module-info.class' not in archive.namelist(): raise ValueError('Missing module descriptor: '+str(jar))
        destination=repository/f'com/guicedee/{coordinate}/2.5.1'
        destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(jar,destination/jar.name)
        pom=directory/('flatter.pom' if (directory/'flatter.pom').exists() else 'pom.xml')
        shutil.copy2(pom,destination/f'{name}-2.5.1.pom')
        staged.append({'path':str(jar.relative_to(ROOT.parent)),'sha256':sha(jar)})
    output=ROOT/'guicedee-native/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/dev.guicedee.benchmarks/guicedee-trace'
    metadata=json.loads((trace/'reachability-metadata.json' if trace else output/'reachability-metadata.json').read_text())
    def generated(entry):
        return any(marker in str(entry.get('type','')) for marker in ['$$EnhancerByGuice$$','$$FastClassByGuice$$'])
    metadata['reflection']=[entry for entry in metadata['reflection'] if not generated(entry)]
    for entry in metadata['reflection']:
        name=entry.get('type','')
        if isinstance(name,str) and name.startswith(('com.guicedee.','com.google.inject.','bench.guicedee.','io.swagger.v3.oas.models.')):
            # JVM fast constructors bypass reflection; native Guice uses its reflective fallback.
            entry.update(allDeclaredConstructors=True,allDeclaredMethods=True,allDeclaredFields=True)
        if isinstance(name,str) and name.startswith('com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.handler.ssl.ReferenceCountedOpenSsl'):
            entry['condition']={'typeReached':'com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.internal.tcnative.SSL'}
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (output/'reachability-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+'\n')
    resources=sorted({entry['glob'] for entry in metadata.get('resources',[]) if 'glob' in entry})
    if any(any(char in resource for char in '*\\\"\n') for resource in resources):
        raise ValueError('Expected literal traced resource paths for modular registration')
    (ROOT/'guicedee-native/native-resources.txt').write_text('\n'.join(resources)+'\n')
    manifest={'traceSha256':sha(trace/'reachability-metadata.json') if trace else diagnostic['traceSha256'],
              'metadataSha256':sha(output/'reachability-metadata.json'),
              'sdkJars':sdk_inputs,'frameworkJars':staged,'capabilityCount':15,
              'allCapabilitiesPassed':True,'agentSha256':diagnostic['agentSha256']}
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
    provenance=capture()
    provenance['guicedeeNativeInputs']=manifest
    provenance['guicedeeNativeInputs']['stagedJars']=[{'path':p.relative_to(repository).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(p)}
                                                    for p in sorted(repository.rglob('*.jar'))]
    (ROOT/'docker/build-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Prepared native Guice support and full capability trace; retained verified SDK snapshot.')


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('trace',type=Path,nargs='?',help='Fresh agent trace, or reuse committed metadata for the exact recorded SDKs')
    prepare(parser.parse_args().trace)

"""Verify the independently compiled modular applications before image packaging."""
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile
import subprocess
import os

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DISCOVERY_ENTRIES = {'bench/guicedee/BenchmarkDiscovery.class',
                     'META-INF/services/com.guicedee.client.services.IGuiceDiscovery'}


def verify_scanner_artifact(spi, scanner):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(spi) as original, zipfile.ZipFile(scanner) as scan:
        assert 'module-info.class' in original.namelist(), 'SPI module descriptor is missing'
        assert 'module-info.class' in scan.namelist(), 'Scanner module descriptor is missing'
        assert all(name in original.namelist() for name in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES), 'SPI discovery registration is missing'
        assert not DISCOVERY_ENTRIES.intersection(scan.namelist()), 'Scanner artifact contains explicit discovery'
        assert b'BenchmarkDiscovery' not in scan.read('module-info.class'), 'Scanner descriptor registers discovery'
        business = {name for name in original.namelist() if name.endswith('.class')
                    and name != 'module-info.class' and name not in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES}
        assert business == {name for name in scan.namelist() if name.endswith('.class') and name != 'module-info.class'}, 'Application class sets differ'
        for name in business:
            assert original.read(name) == scan.read(name), f'Business bytecode differs: {name}'


if __name__ == '__main__':
    verify_scanner_artifact(ROOT/'guicedee/target/comparison-guicedee-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar',
                            ROOT/'guicedee-scan/target/comparison-guicedee-scan-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar')
    for application in ['guicedee', 'guicedee-scan']:
        jar = ROOT/application/'target'/('comparison-'+application+'-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar')
        libraries = ROOT/application/'target/lib'

    print('Both module descriptors retained; scanner has no discovery provider; matching business bytecode verified.')

"""Prepare a phase build using an existing, isolated Docker Maven repository snapshot."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import zipfile
from image_provenance import ROOT, capture


def prepare(update_openapi=False):
    repository=ROOT/'docker/repository'
    source=ROOT.parent/'GuicedEE/inject/target/inject-2.5.1.jar'
    target=repository/'com/guicedee/inject/2.5.1/inject-2.5.1.jar'
    if not target.is_file(): raise ValueError('Stage the benchmark Docker repository before building diagnostics')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as jar:
        if not {'module-info.class','com/guicedee/guicedinjection/StartupDiagnostics.class'}.issubset(jar.namelist()):
            raise ValueError('Build the modular inject artifact with startup diagnostics first')
    for name in ['firebase-admin','commercetools']:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(repository/f'com/guicedee/modules/services/{name}/2.5.1/{name}-2.5.1.jar') as jar:
            if 'module-info.class' not in jar.namelist(): raise ValueError('Staged SDK is not modular: '+name)
    shutil.copy2(source,target)
    if update_openapi:
        source=ROOT.parent/'GuicedEE/openapi/target/openapi-2.5.1.jar'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as jar:
            if 'module-info.class' not in jar.namelist(): raise ValueError('OpenAPI artifact must be modular')
        shutil.copy2(source,repository/'com/guicedee/openapi/2.5.1/openapi-2.5.1.jar')
    inputs={'note':'Linux Maven builds the applications from captured sources. Staged artifacts are authoritative; host target JARs are not used.',
            'frameworkSources':[],'stagedJars':[]}
    for filename in ['GuiceApplication.java','GuiceContext.java','StartupDiagnostics.java']:
        path=ROOT.parent/'GuicedEE/inject/src/main/java/com/guicedee/guicedinjection'/filename
        inputs['frameworkSources'].append({'path':path.relative_to(ROOT.parent).as_posix(),
                                         'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    if update_openapi:
        for path in sorted((ROOT.parent/'GuicedEE/openapi/src/main').rglob('*')):
            if path.is_file():
                inputs['frameworkSources'].append({'path':path.relative_to(ROOT.parent).as_posix(),
                    'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'content':path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
    for jar in sorted(repository.rglob('*.jar')):
        inputs['stagedJars'].append({'path':jar.relative_to(repository).as_posix(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(jar.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    provenance=capture()
    provenance.pop('packagedJars')
    provenance['phaseDiagnosticInputs']=inputs
    (ROOT/'docker/build-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print('Prepared phase inputs; retained staged SDKs and updated inject'+(' and OpenAPI.' if update_openapi else '.'))


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--update-openapi',action='store_true',help='Stage the freshly packaged modular OpenAPI artifact')
    prepare(parser.parse_args().update_openapi)

"""Collect SDK reachability metadata with the existing capability workload.

Diagnostic only: the single instrumented JVM cannot form an eligible comparison.
The caller supplies the Mandrel native-image agent shared library on Linux Docker.
"""
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import argparse
import compare


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('agent',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('output',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--framework',choices=['quarkus','guicedee'],default='quarkus')
    parser.add_argument('--image-tag',default='local')
    options=parser.parse_args()
    library=options.agent.resolve()
    output=options.output.resolve()
    if not library.is_file(): raise SystemExit('Native-image agent library is missing')
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):raise SystemExit('Choose a fresh metadata output directory; old traces must not be reused')
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    start=compare.start
    def traced_start(command,log,env,cwd=compare.ROOT):
        if command[:2]==['docker','run'] and '--publish' in command:
            command=list(command)
            # Metadata collection is not a timed comparison and needs extra headroom.
            command[command.index('--cpus')+1]='2'
            command[command.index('--memory')+1]='2g'
            command[command.index('--memory-swap')+1]='2g'
            command[2:2]=['--mount',f'type=bind,source={library},target=/native-agent.so,readonly',
                          '--mount',f'type=bind,source={output},target=/native-metadata']
            launch=command.index('--module-path') if options.framework=='guicedee' else command.index('-jar')
            command[launch:launch]=['--add-modules=jdk.unsupported',
                '-agentpath:/native-agent.so=config-output-dir=/native-metadata,config-write-period-secs=1,config-write-initial-delay-secs=0']
        return start(command,log,env,cwd)
    compare.start=traced_start
    probe=compare.probe
    rows=[]
    outputs=[]
    sdk_jars=[]
    def traced_probe(*args,**kwargs):
        row=probe(*args,**kwargs)
        row['instrumented']=True
        row['diagnosticLimits']='2 CPU / 2 GiB; metadata collection only'
        rows.append(row)
        out=args[2]
        outputs.append(out)
        (out/f"{row['variant']}-{row['run']}.json").write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
        environment=json.loads((out/'environment.json').read_text())
        environment.update(instrumented=True,cpuQuota=row['diagnosticLimits'])
        for sdk in ['firebase-admin','commercetools']:
            artifact=sdk+'-2.5.1.jar'
            provenance=environment['imageBuildProvenance'][options.framework]
            if 'phaseDiagnosticInputs' in provenance:
                matched=[entry for entry in provenance['phaseDiagnosticInputs']['stagedJars']
                         if entry['path'].endswith('/'+artifact)]
            else:
                prefix='quarkus/target/quarkus-app/lib/' if options.framework=='quarkus' else 'guicedee/target/lib/'
                matched=[entry for entry in provenance['packagedJars']
                         if entry['path'].startswith(prefix) and entry['path'].endswith(artifact)]
            if len(matched)!=1:raise RuntimeError('Cannot identify traced SDK artifact: '+artifact)
            sdk_jars.append({'name':artifact,'sha256':matched[0]['sha256']})
        (out/'environment.json').write_text(json.dumps(environment,indent=2)+'\n')
        return row
    compare.probe=traced_probe
    sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],'--docker','--firebase','--framework',options.framework,'--discovery','spi',
              '--image-tag',options.image_tag,'--runs','1','--requests','2','--warmup','1']
    result=compare.main()
    for out in outputs:
        summary=json.loads((out/'summary.json').read_text())
        summary.update(instrumented=True,scope='Native-image agent diagnostic: 2 CPU / 2 GiB; excluded from performance comparisons')
        (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
    # Single-variant diagnostics intentionally return 1 even when all checks pass.
    passed=len(rows)==1 and len(rows[0]['checks'])==15 and all(c['passed'] for c in rows[0]['checks'].values())
    (output/'diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps({'instrumented':True,'performanceComparison':False,
        'harnessExitCode':result,'allCapabilitiesPassed':passed,'checks':rows[0]['checks'] if rows else {},
        'agentSha256':hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'sdkJars':sdk_jars},indent=2)+'\n')
    return 0 if passed and any((output/name).exists() for name in ['reachability-metadata.json','reflect-config.json']) else 1


if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.1.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.1.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.1.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>com.guicedee</groupId>
        <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
        <version>2.5.1</version>
    </parent>
    <groupId>com.guicedee.modules.services</groupId>
    <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId>
    <name>firebase.admin</name>
    <version>2.5.1</version>
    <properties>
        <project.scm.nameUrl>/GuicedEE/Services</project.scm.nameUrl>
    </properties>
    <description>Grouped Firebase Admin and Google SDK JPMS module.</description>
    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>shade</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <relocations combine.self="override">
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>io</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.io</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>org</pattern>
                                    <excludes>
                                        <!-- Native-image hosted APIs are supplied by the compiler, not shaded dependencies. -->
                                        <exclude>org.graalvm.**</exclude>
                                        <!-- JGSS is a JDK API; references must retain the platform package. -->
                                        <exclude>org.ietf.**</exclude>
                                        <!-- Conscrypt's JNI library looks up these original Java class names. -->
                                        <exclude>org.conscrypt.**</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.w3c.**</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.xml.**</exclude>
                                    </excludes>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.org</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.fasterxml</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.fasterxml</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.common</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.common</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.thirdparty</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.thirdparty</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.gson</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.gson</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.errorprone</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.errorprone</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.j2objc</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.j2objc</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.re2j</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.re2j</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>javax.annotation</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.javax.annotation</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.sun</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.sun</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.aayushatharva</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.aayushatharva</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                            </relocations>
                            <artifactSet>
                                <includes>
                                    <include>*:*</include>
                                </includes>
                                <excludes>
                                    <exclude>org.projectlombok:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.junit*:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.apiguardian:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.opentest4j:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>io.projectreactor.tools:*</exclude>
                                </excludes>
                            </artifactSet>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-antrun-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>reset-shaded-documentation</id>
                        <phase>initialize</phase>
                        <goals><goal>run</goal></goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <!-- A wrapper has no own sources: never feed a previous shaded
                                 source archive back into the next shade execution. -->
                            <target>
                                <delete file="${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}-sources.jar"/>
                                <delete file="${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}-shaded-sources.jar"/>
                                <delete file="${project.build.directory}/original-${project.build.finalName}-sources.jar"/>
                                <delete dir="${project.build.directory}/source-output"/>
                                <delete dir="${project.build.directory}/reports/apidocs"/>
                            </target>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.moditect</groupId>
                <artifactId>moditect-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>com.guicedee.maven</groupId>
                <artifactId>flatten-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>com.coderplus.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>copy-rename-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>javadoc</id>
                        <configuration>
                            <!-- Document the Firebase Admin API against this build's binary.
                                 Bundled implementation sources are not a compilable source project. -->
                            <sourceFileIncludes><include>com/google/firebase/**/*.java</include></sourceFileIncludes>
                            <sourceFileExcludes><exclude>com/google/firebase/internal/shaded/**</exclude></sourceFileExcludes>
                            <offlineLinks combine.self="override"/>
                            <additionalOptions combine.self="override">
                                <additionalOption>-Xdoclint:none</additionalOption>
                                <additionalOption>--class-path</additionalOption>
                                <!-- Javadoc executes in target/reports/apidocs; relative paths also
                                     avoid Windows backslash escaping in its argument file. -->
                                <additionalOption>../../${project.build.finalName}.jar</additionalOption>
                                <additionalOption>--source-path</additionalOption>
                                <additionalOption>../../javadoc-empty-sourcepath</additionalOption>
                            </additionalOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
    <url>https://guicedee.com</url>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.firebase</groupId>
            <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId>
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>
    <dependencyManagement>
        <dependencies>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>com.guicedee</groupId>
                <artifactId>standalone-bom</artifactId>
                <version>${guicedee.version}</version>
                <scope>import</scope>
                <type>pom</type>
            </dependency>
        </dependencies>
    </dependencyManagement>
</project>

FROM oraclelinux:9-slim AS stock-runtime
RUN microdnf install -y tar gzip curl ca-certificates && microdnf clean all
RUN curl -fL https://download.oracle.com/java/25/latest/jdk-25_linux-x64_bin.tar.gz -o /tmp/jdk.tar.gz \
    && mkdir -p /opt/java/openjdk && tar -xzf /tmp/jdk.tar.gz -C /opt/java/openjdk --strip-components=1 \
    && sha256sum /tmp/jdk.tar.gz > /oracle-jdk-sha256.txt && rm /tmp/jdk.tar.gz
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/openjdk
ENV PATH=/opt/java/openjdk/bin:$PATH
FROM stock-runtime AS os-source
RUN rm -rf /opt/java/openjdk
FROM scratch AS common-os
COPY --from=os-source / /
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/openjdk
ENV PATH=/opt/java/openjdk/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LANGUAGE=en_US:en LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
WORKDIR /app
COPY docker/build-provenance.json build-provenance.json
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/java"]

FROM common-os AS base
COPY --from=stock-runtime /opt/java/openjdk /opt/java/openjdk

FROM base AS guicedee
COPY guicedee/.env .env
COPY guicedee/target/comparison-guicedee-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
COPY guicedee/target/lib/ lib/
CMD ["--module-path", "/app/app.jar:/app/lib", "-m", "bench.guicedee/bench.guicedee.Main"]

FROM base AS quarkus
COPY quarkus/target/quarkus-app/ ./
CMD ["-jar", "/app/quarkus-run.jar"]

FROM base AS guicedee-scan
COPY guicedee-scan/.env .env
COPY guicedee-scan/target/comparison-guicedee-scan-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
COPY guicedee-scan/target/lib/ lib/
ENV GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE=scan
CMD ["--module-path", "/app/app.jar:/app/lib", "-m", "bench.guicedee.scan/bench.guicedee.Main"]

FROM stock-runtime AS maven-build-base
RUN microdnf install -y binutils && microdnf clean all
ARG MAVEN_VERSION=4.0.0-rc-7
ADD https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/${MAVEN_VERSION}/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}-bin.zip /tmp/maven.zip
RUN cd /opt && jar xf /tmp/maven.zip && chmod +x /opt/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}/bin/mvn && rm /tmp/maven.zip
ENV PATH=/opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7/bin:$PATH
COPY docker/repository/ /root/.m2/repository/
WORKDIR /src
COPY pom.xml pom.xml
COPY common/ common/
COPY guicedee/pom.xml guicedee/pom.xml
COPY guicedee/src/ guicedee/src/
COPY guicedee-scan/pom.xml guicedee-scan/pom.xml
COPY guicedee-scan/src/ guicedee-scan/src/
COPY quarkus/pom.xml quarkus/pom.xml
COPY quarkus/src/ quarkus/src/
COPY quarkus-native/pom.xml quarkus-native/pom.xml
COPY guicedee-jlink/ guicedee-jlink/
COPY guicedee-scan-jlink/ guicedee-scan-jlink/

FROM maven-build-base AS application-build
RUN mvn -B -ntp -pl guicedee-jlink,guicedee-scan-jlink -am package -DskipTests

FROM common-os AS guicedee-jlink
COPY --from=application-build /src/guicedee-jlink/target/maven-jlink/default /opt/java/openjdk
COPY guicedee/.env .env
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark"]

FROM quay.io/quarkus/ubi9-quarkus-mandrel-builder-image:jdk-25@sha256:c0ff31764f70469795db5513d674e4721fd8e7e761beddbff741ef5d84e79ed3 AS native-build
USER root
COPY --from=maven-build-base /opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7 /opt/maven
COPY --from=maven-build-base /root/.m2/repository /root/.m2/repository
COPY --from=maven-build-base /src /src
WORKDIR /src
COPY quarkus-native/src/ quarkus-native/src/
COPY quarkus-native/native-metadata-inputs.json quarkus-native/native-metadata-inputs.json
RUN native-image --version > /native-build-info.txt && \
    /opt/maven/bin/mvn -B -ntp -pl quarkus-native -am package -Pnative -DskipTests && \
    sha256sum /src/quarkus-native/target/*-runner >> /native-build-info.txt

FROM common-os AS quarkus-native
COPY --from=native-build /src/quarkus-native/target/*-runner /app/application
COPY --from=native-build /native-build-info.txt /app/native-build-info.txt
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/application"]

FROM common-os AS guicedee-scan-jlink
COPY --from=application-build /src/guicedee-scan-jlink/target/maven-jlink/default /opt/java/openjdk
COPY guicedee-scan/.env .env
ENV GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE=scan
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark"]

METRICS_PROMETHEUS_ENABLED=true
METRICS_PROMETHEUS_ENDPOINT=/metrics
TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false
