"""Fresh-process capability and latency comparison; failed parity never becomes a performance win."""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import socket
import statistics
import subprocess
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from upstream import Upstream
from variants import select_variants, ordered_variants, guicedee_jar, guicedee_project, runtime_flags

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def request(base, path, body=None, raw=None, headers=None, timeout=15):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(base+path, data=data, headers=headers or {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
            status, content = response.status, response.read().decode()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as response:
        with response:
            status, content = response.code, response.read().decode()
    try: parsed = json.loads(content)
    except ValueError: parsed = content
    return status, parsed, (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000


def port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def stop(process):
    if process.poll() is not None: return
    if os.name == "nt":
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    else:
        import signal
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    try: process.wait(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        if os.name != "nt": os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait(timeout=5)


def start(command, log, env, cwd=ROOT):
    return subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP if os.name == "nt" else 0,
                            start_new_session=os.name != "nt")


def percentile(values, quantile):
    return sorted(values)[min(len(values)-1, int((len(values)-1)*quantile))]


def metric_counts(body):
    if not isinstance(body, str): return {}
    values = {}
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('#') or 'benchmark_quotes' not in line: continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?)\s+([0-9.eE+\-]+)(?:\s+[0-9]+)?', line)
        if match: values[match[1]] = float(match[2])
    return values


def eligible_comparison(rows, runs, variants):
    expected = {(v['id'], run) for v in variants for run in range(1, runs+1)}
    actual = {(r.get('variant'), r.get('run')) for r in rows}
    return len(variants) > 1 and len(rows) == len(expected) and actual == expected and all(r.get('eligible', False) for r in rows)


def discovery_evidence(log, discovery):
    scanning = 'Initializing ClassGraph scanner for dependency discovery' in log
    deployments = {package: f'Deploying Verticle: {package} -' in log
                   for package in ['bench.guicedee.rest', 'bench.guicedee.service']}
    return {'classGraphInitialized':scanning, 'verticleDeployments':deployments,
            'verified':scanning == (discovery == 'scan') and all(deployments.values()),
            'logLines':[line for line in log.splitlines() if any(marker in line for marker in
                         ['Initializing ClassGraph', 'Classpath scan completed', 'Deploying Verticle: bench.guicedee'])]}


def probe(variant, run, out, upstream, flags, args):
    flags = runtime_flags(variant, flags)
    framework = variant['framework']
    application = guicedee_project(variant) if framework == 'guicedee' else variant['id']
    app_port = port()
    env = dict(os.environ, HTTP_PORT=str(app_port), HTTPS_ENABLED="false", HTTP_HOST="127.0.0.1",
               BENCH_UPSTREAM=f"http://127.0.0.1:{upstream.server_port}", FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST="127.0.0.1:18088",
               GCLOUD_PROJECT="demo-devsuite")
    # Remove implicit JVM tuning from the parent so both variants receive exactly the recorded flags.
    for name in ["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS"]: env.pop(name, None)
    if framework == "guicedee":
        env['GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE']=variant['discovery']
        cp = (ROOT/application/'target/classpath.txt').read_text().strip() if not args.docker else ''
        module = 'bench.guicedee.scan' if variant['discovery'] == 'scan' else 'bench.guicedee'
        launch = ['--module-path', str(ROOT/application/'target'/guicedee_jar(variant))+os.pathsep+cp, '-m', module+'/bench.guicedee.Main']
    else: launch = [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['-jar', str(ROOT/'quarkus/target/quarkus-app/quarkus-run.jar')]
    name = f'{variant["id"]}-{run}'
    container = None
    if args.docker:
        container = 'devsuite-bench-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        env.update(HTTP_PORT='8080', HTTP_HOST='0.0.0.0', QUARKUS_HTTP_HOST='0.0.0.0',
                   BENCH_UPSTREAM=f'http://host.docker.internal:{upstream.server_port}',
                   FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST='host.docker.internal:18088')
        launch = (['-m', module+'/bench.guicedee.Main'] if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else ['--module-path','/app/app.jar:/app/lib','-m',module+'/bench.guicedee.Main']) if framework=='guicedee' else [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['-jar','/app/quarkus-run.jar']
    argfile = out/(name+'.args')
    argfile.write_text('\n'.join('"'+a.replace('\\','/')+'"' for a in flags+launch)+'\n')
    log = (out/(name+'.log')).open('w')
    started = time.perf_counter()
    command = [shutil.which('java'), '@'+str(argfile)]
    if variant['runtime'] == 'jlink' and not container:
        launcher = ROOT/(application+'-jlink')/'target/maven-jlink/default/bin'/('benchmark.bat' if os.name == 'nt' else 'benchmark')
        if not launcher.is_file(): raise RuntimeError('Build the application jlink module first: '+str(launcher))
        env['JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS']=' '.join(flags)
        command = [str(launcher)]
    if container:
        command = ['docker','run','--name',container,'--cpus','0.25','--memory','500m','--memory-swap','500m',
                   '--publish',f'127.0.0.1:{app_port}:8080']
        for key in ['HTTP_PORT','HTTPS_ENABLED','HTTP_HOST','QUARKUS_HTTP_HOST','BENCH_UPSTREAM','FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST',
                    'GCLOUD_PROJECT']:
            command += ['--env',key+'='+env[key]]
        if framework=='guicedee':
            # Defaults stay in the image's .env. Explicit host overrides retain their normal precedence.
            for key in sorted(env):
                if key.startswith(('GUICEDEE_', 'VERTX_', 'METRICS_', 'TELEMETRY_', 'OTEL_')):
                    command += ['--env',key+'='+env[key]]
            local_env=ROOT/application/'.env.local'
            if local_env.exists():
                command += ['--mount',f'type=bind,source={local_env},target=/app/.env.local,readonly']
        if variant['runtime'] == 'jlink':
            command += ['--env', 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS='+' '.join(flags), args.images[variant['id']]]
        else:
            command += [args.images[variant['id']],*flags,*launch]
    process = start(command, log, env, ROOT/application)
    base = f'http://127.0.0.1:{app_port}'
    row = {'framework': framework, 'variant': variant['id'], 'discovery': variant['discovery'],
           'runtime': variant['runtime'], 'run': run, 'checks': {}, 'samples': [],
           'runtimeFlags':flags, 'jvmFlags':[] if variant['runtime']=='native' else flags,
           'jvmFlagsSource':'not-applicable' if variant['runtime']=='native' else 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS' if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else 'arguments',
           'launch': (['/app/application',*flags] if variant['runtime']=='native' else [('/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark' if container else str(launcher))] if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else flags+launch)}
    event_start = len(upstream.events)
    def check(name, condition, observed):
        row['checks'][name] = {'passed': bool(condition), 'observed': observed}
    try:
        deadline = started + 120
        while time.perf_counter() < deadline:
            if process.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError(f'Application exited {process.returncode}; see {name}.log')
            try:
                response = request(base, '/ready', timeout=.5)
                if response[:2] == (200, {'ready': True}): break
            except (OSError, TimeoutError): pass
            time.sleep(.05)
        else: raise TimeoutError('Readiness timed out')
        row['launchToReadyMs'] = (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
        route = '/quote?persist=true' if args.firebase else '/quote'
        order = {'sku': 'fixture', 'quantity': 2}
        expected = {'sku': 'fixture', 'quantity': 2, 'total': 250, 'available': 40, 'project': 'Fixture shop'}
        status, body, latency = request(base, route, order, timeout=60 if args.docker else 15)
        row['firstBusinessStatus'] = status
        row['firstBusinessMs'] = latency
        row['launchToFirstBusinessMs'] = (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000
        check('business', status == 200 and body == expected, {'status': status, 'body': body})
        events = upstream.events[event_start:]
        for label, path in [('vendorSdkOAuth','/oauth/token'),('vendorSdkRest','/benchmark'),('graphqlClient','/benchmark/graphql')]:
            hits = [e for e in events if e['path'] == path]
            check(label, bool(hits) and all(e['status']==200 for e in hits), hits)
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/quote', order)
        check('optionalPrimitiveQuery', status==200 and body==expected, {'status':status,'body':body})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/quote?persist=false', {'sku':'fixture','quantity':0})
        check('validationError', status==400 and body=={'error':{'code':'INVALID_ORDER','status':400}}, {'status':status,'body':body})
        for label, data, header, expected_status in [('malformedJson',b'{',{'Content-Type':'application/json'},400),
                                                    ('unsupportedMedia',b'hello',{'Content-Type':'text/plain'},415)]:
            status, body, _ = request(base, '/quote?persist=false', raw=data, headers=header)
            check(label, status==expected_status, {'status':status,'body':body})
        retry_id = name
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/retry/'+retry_id)
        attempts = upstream.counts['/flaky/'+retry_id]
        check('reactiveRetry', status==200 and body=={'result':'ok'} and attempts==3, {'status':status,'body':body,'attempts':attempts})
        previous = upstream.counts['/flaky/always']
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/retry/always')
        attempts = upstream.counts['/flaky/always']-previous
        check('retryExhaustion', status==502 and body=={'error':{'code':'UPSTREAM_FAILURE','status':502}} and attempts==3,
              {'status':status,'body':body,'attempts':attempts})
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as pool:
            pending = pool.submit(request, base, '/timeout')
            time.sleep(.02)
            _, _, ready_ms = request(base, '/ready')
            status, body, elapsed = pending.result()
        check('reactiveTimeout', status==504 and body=={'error':{'code':'UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT','status':504}} and elapsed<(1000 if args.docker else 225),
              {'status':status,'body':body,'elapsedMs':elapsed,'concurrentReadyMs':ready_ms})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/metrics', headers={})
        before = metric_counts(body)
        request(base, route, order)
        after_status, after_body, _ = request(base, '/metrics', headers={})
        after = metric_counts(after_body)
        check('metrics', status==200 and after_status==200 and any(after.get(k,0)>v for k,v in before.items()),
              {'status':status,'before':before,'after':after})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/openapi.json', headers={'Accept':'application/json'})
        check('openapi', status==200 and isinstance(body,dict) and '/quote' in body.get('paths',{}), {'status':status,'paths':list(body.get('paths',{})) if isinstance(body,dict) else body[:300]})
        status, body, _ = request(base, '/swagger/' if framework=='quarkus' else '/swagger/index.html', headers={})
        check('swagger', status==200 and isinstance(body,str) and 'swagger' in body.lower(), {'status':status})
        if args.firebase:
            status, body, _ = request(base, '/firebase/'+name)
            check('firebaseFirestore', status==200 and body=={'id':name,'sku':'fixture','total':250}, {'status':status,'body':body})
        else: row['checks']['firebaseFirestore']={'passed':False,'status':'not_run','reason':'--firebase not selected'}
        # Diagnostic warm latency is retained even if parity fails; reports cannot rank that run.
        for _ in range(args.warmup): request(base, route, order)
        for _ in range(args.requests):
            status, body, elapsed = request(base, route, order)
            row['samples'].append({'ms':elapsed,'ok':status==200 and body==expected,'status':status})
        times=[s['ms'] for s in row['samples']]
        row['warm']={'p50Ms':statistics.median(times),'p95Ms':percentile(times,.95),'p99Ms':percentile(times,.99),
                     'failures':sum(not s['ok'] for s in row['samples']), 'requests':len(times),'concurrency':1}
        row['eligible'] = all(c['passed'] for c in row['checks'].values()) and row['warm']['failures']==0
    except Exception as error:
        row['error']=str(error);row['eligible']=False
    finally:
        if container:
            inspected=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect',container],capture_output=True,text=True)
            if inspected.returncode==0:
                details=json.loads(inspected.stdout)[0]
                row['container']={'image':details['Image'],'state':details['State'],
                                  'nanoCpus':details['HostConfig']['NanoCpus'],'memoryBytes':details['HostConfig']['Memory'],
                                  'memorySwapBytes':details['HostConfig']['MemorySwap']}
                row['containerStats']=subprocess.run(['docker','exec',container,'sh','-c',
                    'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events'],
                    capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
                if row['container']['nanoCpus']!=250000000 or row['container']['memoryBytes']!=524288000 or details['State']['OOMKilled']:
                    row['eligible']=False
            else: row['eligible']=False
            subprocess.run(['docker','rm','-f',container],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        stop(process);log.close()
        if framework == 'guicedee':
            row['discoveryEvidence']=discovery_evidence((out/(name+'.log')).read_text(errors='replace'), variant['discovery'])
            row['eligible']=row['eligible'] and row['discoveryEvidence']['verified']
        row['upstreamEvents']=upstream.events[event_start:]
        (out/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')

"""Retain observed SDK reflection/resources from a passing diagnostic agent run."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import zipfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    if len(sys.argv)!=2: raise SystemExit('Usage: import_native_trace.py <agent-output-directory>')
    directory=Path(sys.argv[1])
    diagnostic=json.loads((directory/'diagnostic.json').read_text())
    if not diagnostic.get('allCapabilitiesPassed'): raise SystemExit('All workload checks must pass before importing a trace')
    source=directory/'reachability-metadata.json'
    metadata=json.loads(source.read_text())
    entries=set()
    inputs=[]
    for path in (ROOT/'guicedee/target/classpath.txt').read_text().strip().split(os.pathsep):
        jar=Path(path)
        if jar.name not in ['commercetools-2.5.1.jar','firebase-admin-2.5.1.jar']:continue
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive: entries.update(archive.namelist())
        inputs.append({'name':jar.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(jar.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    classes={entry[:-6].replace('/','.') for entry in entries if entry.endswith('.class')}
    selected={'reflection':[entry for entry in metadata.get('reflection',[])
                            if isinstance(entry.get('type'),str) and entry['type'].removesuffix('[]') in classes],
              'resources':[entry for entry in metadata.get('resources',[]) if entry.get('glob') in entries]}
    # The JVM agent observes class-name queries for optional OpenSSL exception
    # types. Retain these only with their backend; otherwise native-image roots
    # the outer engine's initializer, which cannot run without tcnative either.
    for entry in selected['reflection']:
        if entry['type'].startswith('com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.handler.ssl.ReferenceCountedOpenSsl'):
            entry['condition']={'typeReached':'com.commercetools.internal.shaded.io.netty.internal.tcnative.SSL'}
    target=ROOT/'quarkus-native/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/dev.guicedee.benchmarks/sdk-trace'
    target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (target/'reachability-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(selected,indent=2)+'\n')
    (ROOT/'quarkus-native/native-trace-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps({
        'agentSha256':diagnostic['agentSha256'],'traceSha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'allCapabilitiesPassed':True,'sdkJars':inputs,'included':{key:len(value) for key,value in selected.items()},
        'scope':'Only types and resources owned by the two SDK wrapper JARs; no workload code changes'},indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Imported SDK reachability metadata:',{key:len(value) for key,value in selected.items()})


if __name__=='__main__':main()

                     'META-INF/services/com.guicedee.client.services.IGuiceDiscovery'}


def verify_scanner_artifact(spi, scanner):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(spi) as original, zipfile.ZipFile(scanner) as scan:
        assert 'module-info.class' in original.namelist(), 'SPI module descriptor is missing'
        assert 'module-info.class' in scan.namelist(), 'Scanner module descriptor is missing'
        assert all(name in original.namelist() for name in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES), 'SPI discovery registration is missing'

                    and name != 'module-info.class' and name not in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES}
        assert business == {name for name in scan.namelist() if name.endswith('.class') and name != 'module-info.class'}, 'Application class sets differ'
        for name in business:
            assert original.read(name) == scan.read(name), f'Business bytecode differs: {name}'

        try:
            self.assertEqual(401, request(base,'/benchmark')[0])
            self.assertEqual(401, request(base,'/oauth/token',raw=b'grant_type=client_credentials')[0])
            self.assertEqual(200, request(base,'/oauth/token',raw=b'grant_type=client_credentials',headers={'Authorization':'Basic Zml4dHVyZTpmaXh0dXJl'})[0])
            self.assertEqual([503,503,200],[request(base,'/flaky/test')[0] for _ in range(3)])
            self.assertEqual(3,server.counts['/flaky/test'])
            self.assertEqual(400,request(base,'/benchmark/graphql',{'query':'{ inventoryEntries }'})[0])
            self.assertEqual(200,request(base,'/benchmark/graphql',{'query':'{ inventoryEntries }'},headers={'Authorization':'Bearer fixture-token'})[0])

"""Collect SDK reachability metadata with the existing capability workload.

Diagnostic only: the single instrumented JVM cannot form an eligible comparison.
The caller supplies the Mandrel native-image agent shared library on Linux Docker.
"""
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import compare


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        raise SystemExit('Usage: trace_native.py <libnative-image-agent.so> <output-directory>')
    library=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    output=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
    if not library.is_file(): raise SystemExit('Native-image agent library is missing')
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    start=compare.start
    def traced_start(command,log,env,cwd=compare.ROOT):
        if command[:2]==['docker','run'] and '--publish' in command:
            command=list(command)
            # Metadata collection is not a timed comparison and needs extra headroom.
            command[command.index('--cpus')+1]='2'
            command[command.index('--memory')+1]='2g'
            command[command.index('--memory-swap')+1]='2g'
            command[2:2]=['--mount',f'type=bind,source={library},target=/native-agent.so,readonly',
                          '--mount',f'type=bind,source={output},target=/native-metadata']
            command.insert(command.index('-jar'),'-agentpath:/native-agent.so=config-output-dir=/native-metadata,config-write-period-secs=1,config-write-initial-delay-secs=0')
        return start(command,log,env,cwd)
    compare.start=traced_start
    probe=compare.probe
    rows=[]
    def traced_probe(*args,**kwargs):
        row=probe(*args,**kwargs)
        row['instrumented']=True
        row['diagnosticLimits']='2 CPU / 2 GiB; metadata collection only'
        rows.append(row)
        out=args[2]
        (out/f"{row['variant']}-{row['run']}.json").write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
        environment=json.loads((out/'environment.json').read_text())
        environment.update(instrumented=True,cpuQuota=row['diagnosticLimits'])
        (out/'environment.json').write_text(json.dumps(environment,indent=2)+'\n')
        return row
    compare.probe=traced_probe
    sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],'--docker','--firebase','--framework','quarkus','--runs','1','--requests','2','--warmup','1']
    result=compare.main()
    # Single-variant diagnostics intentionally return 1 even when all checks pass.
    passed=len(rows)==1 and len(rows[0]['checks'])==15 and all(c['passed'] for c in rows[0]['checks'].values())
    (output/'diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps({'instrumented':True,'performanceComparison':False,
        'harnessExitCode':result,'allCapabilitiesPassed':passed,'checks':rows[0]['checks'] if rows else {},
        'agentSha256':hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
    return 0 if passed and any((output/name).exists() for name in ['reachability-metadata.json','reflect-config.json']) else 1


if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.1.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.1.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.1.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>com.guicedee</groupId>
        <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
        <version>2.5.1</version>
    </parent>
    <groupId>com.guicedee.modules.services</groupId>
    <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId>
    <name>firebase.admin</name>
    <version>2.5.1</version>
    <properties>
        <project.scm.nameUrl>/GuicedEE/Services</project.scm.nameUrl>
    </properties>
    <description>Grouped Firebase Admin and Google SDK JPMS module.</description>
    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>shade</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <relocations combine.self="override">
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>io</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.io</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>org</pattern>
                                    <excludes>
                                        <!-- Native-image hosted APIs are supplied by the compiler, not shaded dependencies. -->
                                        <exclude>org.graalvm.**</exclude>
                                        <!-- JGSS is a JDK API; references must retain the platform package. -->
                                        <exclude>org.ietf.**</exclude>
                                        <!-- Conscrypt's JNI library looks up these original Java class names. -->
                                        <exclude>org.conscrypt.**</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.w3c.**</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.xml.**</exclude>
                                    </excludes>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.org</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.fasterxml</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.fasterxml</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.common</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.common</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.thirdparty</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.thirdparty</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.gson</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.gson</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.errorprone</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.errorprone</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.j2objc</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.j2objc</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.re2j</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.re2j</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>javax.annotation</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.javax.annotation</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.sun</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.sun</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.aayushatharva</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.aayushatharva</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                            </relocations>
                            <artifactSet>
                                <includes>
                                    <include>*:*</include>
                                </includes>
                                <excludes>
                                    <exclude>org.projectlombok:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.junit*:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.apiguardian:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.opentest4j:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>io.projectreactor.tools:*</exclude>
                                </excludes>
                            </artifactSet>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-antrun-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.moditect</groupId>
                <artifactId>moditect-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>com.guicedee.maven</groupId>
                <artifactId>flatten-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>com.coderplus.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>copy-rename-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
    <url>https://guicedee.com</url>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.firebase</groupId>
            <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId>
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>
    <dependencyManagement>
        <dependencies>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>com.guicedee</groupId>
                <artifactId>standalone-bom</artifactId>
                <version>${guicedee.version}</version>
                <scope>import</scope>
                <type>pom</type>
            </dependency>
        </dependencies>
    </dependencyManagement>
</project>
